# Reveal.js assets

Vendored from the official `reveal.js` npm package, version **6.0.2**. Only the runtime files used by this deck are included so the presentation works offline:

- `dist/reveal.js`, `dist/reveal.css`, `dist/reset.css`
- `dist/plugin/notes.js`, `dist/plugin/zoom.js`

The upstream MIT license is in `LICENSE`. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/reveal.js
